# Overview Save Forecast Summaries generated by GitHub Actions runs of forecast bot  
- An important part of the forecast process is that summaries of all forecasts are saved for analysis

# Desired behavior
- When a workflow is triggered on Github with "dre_run_bot_on_tournament.yaml"
    - A forecast is made by the bot (consisting of multiple scenarios and multiple LLM calls)
    - The multiple scenarios are aggregated into a single forecast
    - Three summary files are generated for the forecast (summary, condensed summary, data json)
    - The forecast and a summary file is submitted to Metaculus
    - All forecast summary files are retained and saved for the maximum period allowed (GitHub artifact?)
    - Preferably, summaries for **all** questions forecast in the tournament would be 

# Actual behavior
- Forecast is created, summary is created, both are submitted to Metaculus (as expected)
- In logs, the section called "Upload forecast summaries" (see example below) 
    - shows url to download summaries: URL: .../runs/20793105675/artifacts/5053796530
    - could the file be repeatedly over written?
- **Clicking on the link downloads a zip file that always summaries for exactly 3 questions**
    - The exemption is the first two zip files which contain summaries for 1 and then 2 questions
    - After that, zipfiles always contain the summaries for the same two questions, plus the most recent question.
- It appears, the summaries for the most recent question is only written if the link is clicked before the next run.

# Some hypothesis and speculative solutions
- The file name or location never changes, the file is overwritten each run.
- There is a limited number of summaries allowed in the zip file
- Maybe a script could be run every 20 minutes to copy the summary files to another location


# Example Contents from Upload forecast summaries portion of the logs

## Example 1

Run actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: forecast-summaries
    path: forecast_summaries/
    retention-days: 90
    if-no-files-found: warn
    compression-level: 6
    overwrite: false
    include-hidden-files: false
  env:
    pythonLocation: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11.14/x64
    PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11.14/x64/lib/pkgconfig
    Python_ROOT_DIR: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11.14/x64
    Python2_ROOT_DIR: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11.14/x64
    Python3_ROOT_DIR: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11.14/x64
    LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11.14/x64/lib
    VENV: .venv/bin/activate
